name: Home Front
description: Keeps tabs on a veteran's VA appointments, claim progress and benefit status, and surfaces verified-military discounts the household is actually eligible for. Requires access to VA.gov to be useful, and is built around one household's circumstances rather than general benefits advice.

official.title: Home Front by Diego
official.description: Tracks a veteran's VA.gov appointments, claims, and benefits, and flags ID.me-style deals the household actually qualifies for. Runs alone: reads VA.gov...
